verdict.rationale: Weave's own materials explicitly claim "powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions," and the evaluations guide says it lets you "compare changes over time, and identify regressions" across repeatable test cases. Apples-to-apples evaluations and leaderboards that aggregate evaluations reinforce cross-version comparison. missing for 10: detailed docs on the side-by-side comparison view itself (per-example diffs, metric deltas between prompt/model versions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
